findings.title: Concurrent migration destination arrival is overwritten by native replacing rename
findings.reproduction: Run /workspace/scratch/parity-toolchain/ci-bin/luajit /workspace/scratch/parity-recovery/linux-migration/probes/native.lua race. A real destination is created at the checked rename boundary, then original native os.rename overwrites it; the report records a successful move with no backup.
findings.root_cause: _shared/lua/legacy_folder_migration.lua:75–80,90–115 checks target absence separately from effect; linux/infra/legacy_folder_migration.lua:66 uses replacing os.rename. Direct boot migration125 precedes singleton acquire822.
findings.silent_failure: Only successful move info is recorded; the new target bytes disappear without a kept/backup refusal. Existing in-memory ports refuse target replacement and miss native semantics.
findings.regression_test: Actual native race for destination and backup must preserve newer bytes and retain/refuse legacy bytes atomically; retain ordinary no-clash success.

basis.native_limits: No full daemon, desktop, user HOME/XDG, native input, clipboard or secrets; race inserts controlled real arrival before original os.rename.

findings.title: Newline-bearing legacy filenames are split and silently skipped
findings.reproduction: Run /workspace/scratch/parity-toolchain/ci-bin/luajit /workspace/scratch/parity-recovery/linux-migration/probes/native.lua newline. Create actual legacy filename line\nbreak with LF; real ls returns two names; two repeated migrations report moved0/kept0 and leave original entry at obsolete root.
findings.root_cause: linux/infra/legacy_folder_migration.lua:57–61 frames ls output by lines; shared apply146–150 trusts fabricated names and move_entry91 silently skips missing names.
findings.silent_failure: No attempted source name exists and no kept/error is generated; migration logs do not identify the unprocessed actual name.
findings.regression_test: Enumerate exact POSIX names including LF and require actual original bytes moved or an explicit refusal; preserve quote/tab/Unicode/dash/backslash controls.

findings.title: Relocated configuration directory retains its obsolete native bootstrap locator
findings.reproduction: Run /workspace/scratch/parity-toolchain/ci-bin/luajit /workspace/scratch/parity-recovery/linux-migration/probes/native.lua override. Seed legacy storage paths.config_dir pointing at a valid custom directory beneath legacy root; migrate; actual Storage loads moved JSON but actual ConfigPaths.config resolves the missing old path while bytes exist under new root.
findings.root_cause: linux/infra/legacy_folder_migration.lua:86–108 moves entries without reconciling paths.config_dir. linux/infra/config_paths.lua:127–139 trusts that absolute locator; storage76–84 reads relocated bootstrap JSON unchanged.
findings.silent_failure: Migration records successful moves and boot receives no warning that the selected config path was displaced.
findings.regression_test: Keep active identity for migrated nested overrides, including restart; default and unrelated external overrides must remain correct.

findings.title: Native directory enumeration failure is accepted as an empty successful scan
findings.reproduction: Run /workspace/scratch/parity-toolchain/ci-bin/luajit /workspace/scratch/parity-recovery/linux-migration/probes/list-permission.lua <owned-empty-dir>. At actual uid1000 chmod legacy source directory with storage.json to000; actual ls fails but report moved0/kept0/cachetrue. Restore access and same owner moves1.
findings.root_cause: linux/infra/legacy_folder_migration.lua:57–64 ignores pipe.close exit acknowledgment; shared apply146 treats missing list as empty and152–155 drops failed final removal.
findings.silent_failure: ls stderr is discarded and report contains no kept/refusal entry, so log_report has no failure to publish before new bootstrap lookup.
findings.regression_test: Actual inaccessible source must yield explicit refused enumeration; distinguish missing, truly empty, failed/partial listings and successful retry.

findings.title: Legacy root aliasing current root archives active configuration as its own conflict
findings.reproduction: Run /workspace/scratch/parity-toolchain/ci-bin/luajit /workspace/scratch/parity-recovery/linux-migration/probes/native.lua alias. Create current ergopti/config.toml then legacy ergopti_plus symlink to ergopti. Actual migration archives ACTIVE into current backup and removes selected config. Next migration cannot restore it and tries an ancestor-to-descendant move.
findings.root_cause: Linux plan86–95 and shared apply143–150/move_entry90–105 compare textual names without physical root/entry identity, then back up the same source/destination object.
findings.silent_failure: A clash warning is emitted but represents the same live object as two independent stores; default config absence is not diagnosed or repaired.
findings.regression_test: Same-root symlink aliases must preserve current files and be idempotent; include intermediate aliases and genuine distinct-root conflict controls.
